title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on Whether the Share of Debts of Each Party within a Partnership Shall Be Determined Concurrently in the Trial of Cases Concerning Disputes over External Debts of Joint Venture Partnerships and Individual Partnerships

articles.content_en:
Supreme People's Court's Reply
on Whether the Debt Shares of Each Party within the Partnership Shall Be Determined
Concurrently in the Trial of Disputes over External Debts of
Partnership-Type Joint Operation Entities and Individual Partnerships
Fa Han [1992] No. 34
The Higher People's Court of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region:
Your Request for Instructions (Gui Fa (Jing) Zi No. 23 [1991]) on Whether the Debt Shares of Each Party within the Partnership Shall Be Determined Concurrently in the Trial of Disputes over External Debts of Partnership-Type Joint Operation Entities and Individual Partnerships has been received. Upon study, the reply is as follows:
Where the property of a partnership-type joint operation entity or an individual partnership is sufficient to satisfy the debts of the joint operation or partnership, the debts shall be satisfied with the property of the partnership-type joint operation entity or the individual partnership.
Where the partnership-type joint operation entity or the individual partnership has no property to satisfy the debts, or its property is insufficient to satisfy the debts of the joint operation or partnership, the members of the joint operation or the partners shall assume liability. In accordance with the provisions of the General Principles of the Civil Law of the People's Republic of China, unless otherwise provided by law, the partners shall bear joint and several liability for the debts of the partnership; and the parties to a partnership-type joint operation who bear joint and several liability in accordance with the provisions of law or the stipulations of the agreement shall bear joint and several liability. If the rights and obligations among the members of the joint operation entity or among the partners are clear, the shares of debt to be borne by each member of the joint operation entity or each partner are easy to determine, and there is no substantial dispute among the members of the joint operation entity or the partners, then for the purpose of simplifying the litigation procedure, the shares of debt to be borne by each party of the joint operation or partnership may be determined concurrently when trying the case of disputes over external debts of the partnership-type joint operation entity or the individual partnership, provided that the judgment document shall indicate that the parties to the partnership-type joint operation or the partners bear joint and several liability. If there is a substantial dispute among the parties to the joint operation or the partners regarding how to assume liability, and trying the dispute over external debts of the joint operation entity or partnership organization concurrently with the dispute over the joint operation or partnership would not facilitate the timely conclusion of the case, the two may be tried separately. If, in accordance with the provisions of law or the stipulations of the agreement, the parties to a partnership-type joint operation do not bear joint and several liability for the debts of the joint operation, then when trying the case of disputes over external debts of the partnership-type joint operation entity, the shares of debt to be borne by each party to the joint operation for discharging the debts must be determined.
March 18, 1992
